prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1079; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was moving slowly through the turn when the impact came. My head hit the window frame, and I was dazed and had a headache and ringing in my ears afterward. A medical professional later diagnosed me with a concussion. I have given the same account of what happened every time I have described it, to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to my doctor. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle at the time. I am requesting coverage for my medical care, time away from work, and the repair of my car.
